## Release v0.6.1

Compare changes: https://github.com/makcimbx/opencode-pty/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

- test: resolve host TUI peers without unpacking renderer dependencies (99d96db)
- fix: align native TUI peer dependencies for OpenCode installation (3a59c92)

### Installation

Add to your `opencode.json`:

#### OpenCode 2.0

```json
{
  "plugins": [{ "package": "@makcimbx/opencode-pty" }]
}
```

#### OpenCode V1 (1.18.29 or newer)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["@makcimbx/opencode-pty"]
}
```

### Update Instructions

To get the latest version:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/@makcimbx/opencode-pty
opencode
```

releases.name: v0.5.0 — OpenCode 2.0 support
releases.body:
## OpenCode 2.0 support

- Add a shared entrypoint for OpenCode 2.0 and OpenCode V1 1.18.29 or newer.
- Register all eight PTY tools and both Web UI commands through the V2 API.
- Support V2 ordered shell permissions and queued synthetic exit notifications.
- Clean up PTY sessions, the Web UI server, and event subscriptions when the V2 plugin unloads.
- Provide an explicit @makcimbx/opencode-pty/v1 entrypoint for V1 wrapper plugins.

### OpenCode 2.0 configuration

```json
{
  "plugins": [{ "package": "@makcimbx/opencode-pty" }]
}
```

### OpenCode V1 configuration

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": ["@makcimbx/opencode-pty"]
}
```

Fully quit and restart OpenCode after updating the plugin.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@makcimbx/opencode-pty/v/0.5.0
